_readme: This contract defines Qoder CLI's stream-JSON vocabulary. The Go provider reads lifecycle and control frames. The TypeScript plugin classifies transcript frames. The stream envelope resembles Claude Code's, but its behavior differs, so the two providers have separate contracts. `frameKinds` lists top-level `type` values. `controlRequestSubtypes` lists control-channel requests. `systemSubtypes` lists system-line events. `modes` lists the wire permission values in camelCase; launch flags use snake_case. `effortLevels` lists values accepted by `--reasoning-effort`. `permissionOutcomes` lists tool-decision results. `capabilities` lists the features from the init frame. Go-only control-answer fields and goal tool names live in providers/qoder/protocol.go.
